$meta.name: OGeeZ Studios Design System
$meta.values_caveat: HEX values approximated from on-screen rendering of the master Brand Identity kit. Verify with Chubby Studio master swatch before any final print/environmental production.

context.rule: Pick the context BEFORE generating any artifact. Never use 'house' palette for client on-camera work.

electric-green.note: Primary brand color. Wordmark fill. Default house flood.

electric-ultramarine.note: Section dividers, full-bleed cover spreads, supporting field.

epink.note: Wordmark drop-shadow, accent fields, FIXED magenta tooth highlight on mouth (always magenta even on Epink mouth).

black.note: Letterforms, body type, all Arabic typography. Structural, not accent.

coral.note: Mouth color #10, soft flood for data slides

corporate.rule: Restrained. Black + single warm accent. For banks, government, B2B, institutional clients. Examples: Bank Aljazira, NHC CEO Cityscape, Pure Group, Al Jazeera Capital.

consumer.rule: Saturation up. Pattern-forward. For F&B, retail, telco, consumer pop. Examples: Drinkle, Sign Ice Cream, Roshn Hope Core, Daw Shopping.

heritage.rule: Earth tones. Art-direction-heavy. For national days, anniversaries, heritage moments. Examples: NHC National Day, Zaka, Flavor of Homeland.

chart.rule: Bar chart palettes are tonally tuned to the slide background, not fixed deck-wide. Pick the family that matches the slide ground.

mouth.rule: The mouth is a parametric component, not 12 separate illustrations. Single fixed shape, 12 lip colors, 5 treatment modes. Anatomy is sacred — never redraw or AI-regenerate.

parametric-svg.usage: Set CSS `color` property on the parent element (or inline `style="color: <hex>"`) — the SVG lip + shout-lines use currentColor and inherit. Magenta tooth, red tongue, airplane, sparkle, white teeth, black void are baked literals and DO NOT shift.

anatomy-fixed: Outer lip silhouette (color shifts per variant)
Two white highlight glints on upper lip
Black void interior at top of mouth
Airplane silhouette across the teeth (the visual joke — the mouth has bitten an airplane)
Magenta-highlighted single tooth (FIXED — always magenta, even on Epink mouth)
Three shout-lines emanating from left side, color-matched to lip

flat.note: Default. Solid color, no shadow. Lockup, business cards, letterhead, IG posts.

duotone-shadow.note: Mouth in one color with offset shadow in second color. Static but kinetic. See deck slide 6.

motion-trail.note: Extended fading shadow trailing behind mouth toward bottom-left/right. Speed cue. WeTransfer backgrounds.

bleed-off-edge.note: Mouth cropped 25–40% past canvas bounds. Confidence move; signals scale. Deck separator slide 4.

photo-into-mask.note: Photograph clipped inside mouth silhouette as masked vignette. Music-video frame inside vinyl-sticker shape. Deck slide 7.

mood-lockups.rule: Mood-state lockups (Action!/Standby/Wrap/Zzzz/IWD/Halloween) exist as RENDERED IMAGES ONLY. No source files. Do NOT generate new mood lockups via AI/prompt. If a calendar moment needs one, design it manually in the same construction language.

logo.rule: Always use the master files. Never redraw or re-vectorize.

on-black.asset: assets/logo/eps/O!GZ Final AI Logo_ON BLACK BG.eps

on-magenta.asset: assets/logo/eps/O!GZ Final AI Logo_ON LIGHT BACKGROUNDS copy 5.eps

on-green.asset: assets/logo/eps/O!GZ Final AI Logo_ON LIGHT BACKGROUNDS copy 6.eps

on-solid.asset: assets/logo/eps/O!GZ Final AI Logo_ON LIGHT BACKGROUNDS copy 7.eps

clear-space.rule: Minimum clear space = 1X on all four sides, where 1X = half the height of the mouth icon.

typography.pairing-rule: English + Arabic at equal OPTICAL weight, not equal point size. Never set Arabic smaller than English. Arabic is sibling, not subtitle.

case-rules.stationery: ALL CAPS for names + roles (e.g. ALHARETH ALBELAIHED, MANAGING PARTNER)
case-rules.decks: Mixed case for headlines (e.g. Presentation Name/Title)
case-rules.headers-meta: Mixed case for footers and breadcrumbs

deck.left-margin-emphasis: Generous left margin (~20% width) for navigation/numbering, right content well carries weight

stationery.letterhead: A4 (210x297mm); 25mm margins; lockup top-left; legal name top-right; single-line metadata footer
stationery.business-card: 85x55mm horizontal; mouth right ~50%; name+role left third; metadata bottom-left

L1-cover.note: White bg + huge mouth right ~45% + title Modern Era Black mixed-case left + date Regular light-grey bottom-left. NO wordmark on cover — mouth carries identity.

L2-headline-body.note: Full Electric Green flood + small mouth top-left + Headline Bold black + body Regular black + footer bottom-left.

L3-separator-image.note: Full-bleed photo (talent in colored light) + white headline overlaid + subhead Regular.

L4-separator-mouth-bleed.note: Full-bleed Ultramarine (or other primary) + huge cropped mouth bleeding off right edge ~30-40% past bound + headline white left ~20% from edge.

L5-data-pastel.note: Soft secondary flood (coral, sky blue) + small mouth top-left + headline+body left + 5-color bar chart right tuned to bg.

L6-separator-shadow.note: Color flood + huge mouth in second color with offset shadow trail in third color. e.g. mint bg + Epink mouth + green shadow.

L7-separator-photo-mask.note: Color flood + photo masked into mouth-silhouette shape.

L8-data-saturated.note: Saturated secondary flood + bar chart in earth tones.

L9-image-right.note: White bg + small mouth top-left + headline+body left half + full-bleed photo right ~45%.

creative-moves.1-mouth-bleed-off-edge: Mouth cropped 25–40% past canvas bound. Confidence; signals scale.
creative-moves.2-duotone-mouth-shadow: Mouth in color A with offset shadow in color B. Static but kinetic.
creative-moves.3-motion-trail: Fading shadow trailing behind mouth. Speed cue. WeTransfer + motion intros.
creative-moves.5-co-branding-x: OGZ × [Partner] with green × multiplier between marks. e.g. OGZ × Coca-Cola.

voice.rule: See docs/brand-voice-guidelines.md (v4) for full voice/tone. Visual choices serve the voice, not the other way around.
voice.tagline-en: A straight face that makes you laugh.
voice.mission: We don't do aggressive. We don't do gloss.
voice.positioning: Filmmaker-led commercial studio with festival credibility and a bilingual bench.

do-not: Tint the primary palette to pastels.
Skew, stretch, drop-shadow, or re-color the lockup.
Redraw the mouth — color-shift the master, don't regenerate.
Set Arabic smaller than English or as a translation underneath.
Apply the house palette to client on-camera work.
Generate mood-state mouths (Action!/Standby/Halloween) via AI/prompt — they are rendered images only.
Smooth the corporate-precision + punk-zine tension. The tension IS the brand.
